invariants.rationale: Likely required for any operations delegated to HoodieEngineContext or its subtypes.
The instantTime is a required String representing commit instant, which must be non-null for further processing.
The method expects a collection of records to insert; a null value would usually not be allowed.
Typically, there is an expectation that insert has work to do; calling with an empty records list is likely comparatively rare or erroneous.
